content.text:
Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: In ModelAdmin.changelist_view, the POSTed bulk-edit loop (which calls save_form, save_model, save_related, and log_change for each changed form) is now wrapped in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`. This ensures all list_editable changes commit atomically and roll back together if any error occurs, preventing unexpected partial database states. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (admin_changelist) passed — 74 tests, returncode 0.
